headline: United has fewer flights in the air on a lighter schedule.

items.text: 281 United flights are in the air, 59% fewer than usual for this time of day; over the past 7 days, the median at this hour was 680. The schedule is lighter today too, with about 46% fewer departures scheduled from United's hubs over the past four hours than usual.
On time means within 30 minutes of schedule; all seven United hubs reporting so far today are at 85% on time or better.
No FAA ground stop or ground delay program is in effect at any United hub, and weather is not affecting operations at any of the 9 United hubs with a current report.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to a United hub, check your flight status before leaving for the airport.
